description: Defines the TextArea class in the MigraDoc library, representing a chart area that contains text or legend, with methods for cloning, adding elements, and serialization.

classes.name: TextArea
classes.description: Represents a chart area that can contain text, legends, tables, images, and paragraphs, with properties for formatting and serialization.

classes.name: TextArea.TextAreaValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for TextArea, including size, style, formatting, padding, alignment, and elements.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the TextArea object.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph to the text area.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph with specified text to the text area.

methods.name: AddTable
methods.description: Adds a new table to the text area.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds a new image to the text area.

methods.name: AddLegend
methods.description: Adds a new legend to the text area.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an existing paragraph, table, image, or legend to the text area.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the TextArea object into DDL format for serialization.
